:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.4`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noUnreadableIife`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/no-unreadable-iife`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/no-unreadable-iife.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noUnreadableIife": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow immediately called arrow functions whose body is wrapped in parentheses.

An immediately invoked function expression, or IIFE, is a function that is called
right where it is defined, such as `(() => value)()`.

When the body of such an arrow function is also wrapped in parentheses, the code
contains several nested pairs of parentheses. This makes the function look like
a grouped expression and hides where the function body starts and ends.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
const foo = (bar => (bar ? bar.baz : baz))(getBar());
```

### Valid

```js
const bar = getBar();
const foo = bar ? bar.baz : baz;

const getBaz = bar => (bar ? bar.baz : baz);
const qux = getBaz(getBar());

const quux = (bar => {
    return bar ? bar.baz : baz;
})(getBar());
```
